copy.tagline: 把 Slack 频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你开发的应用需要 Slack 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need Slack chat in your app

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把 Slack 适配器接入 NanoClaw:复制适配器与 slack-formatting 技能、按固定版本安装依赖、构建并跑注册测试,然后重启服务;之后你能在 Slack 频道或私信里和它对话,它发的消息按 Slack 的 mrkdwn 语法渲染。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 添加 Slack 频道接入时触发;若正在 /setup 流程中,完成后会回到该流程继续,否则用 /init-first-agent 或 /manage-channels 完成接线。

say.text: 帮我给项目加上 Slack 频道接入
say.note: 会复制适配器并运行注册测试

say.text: 用 Socket Mode 接入 Slack,不要公网地址
say.note: 会引导创建 Slack 应用并收集 xapp- 令牌

say.text: Slack 适配器的注册测试通过了吗?
say.note: 会运行 vitest 注册测试并报告结果

howto.what_en: Claude adds Slack to NanoClaw: it copies the Slack adapter, registration test and slack-formatting skill, installs the pinned package, builds, runs the test, and restarts the service so you can chat in Slack.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add Slack channel integration to NanoClaw, or during the /setup flow that wires channels.

say_en.text: Add Slack channel integration to my project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and runs the registration test

say_en.text: Connect Slack with Socket Mode, no public URL
say_en.note: Guides Slack app creation and the xapp- token paste

say_en.text: Check whether the Slack registration test passes
say_en.note: Runs the vitest registration test and reports the result
